actions.text: Committee on Veterans' Affairs. Ordered to be reported with an amendment in the nature of a substitute favorably.
Committee on Veterans' Affairs. Hearings held. Hearings printed: S.Hrg. 119-86.
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Veterans' Affairs.

dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts veterans enrolled in both Medicare and VA health care living within 3 to 5 selected Veterans Integrated Service Networks.
dimensions.evidence: carry out a pilot program... for covered veterans

dimensions.assessment: Provides assigned case managers, individualized needs assessments, and care coordination plans for participating veterans.
dimensions.evidence: assign each covered veteran participating in the pilot program a case manager responsible for developing an individualized needs assessment

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes contracting with private sector entities for care coordination without stating specific federal funding totals.
dimensions.evidence: contract with private sector entities carrying out commercial health care programs for assistance in designing, implementing, and managing care

dimensions.assessment: Directs the VA to operate a targeted pilot program through its Center for Innovation for Care and Payment.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall carry out the pilot program through the Center for Innovation for Care and Payment of the Department of Veterans Affairs.

dimensions.assessment: Mandates a temporary pilot program lasting for a three-year period.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall carry out the pilot program for a three-year period beginning on the commencement of the pilot program.

missing_information: Total dollar amounts authorized to be appropriated for the pilot program
importance_detail.rationale: Establishes a defined three-year pilot program within 3 to 5 Veterans Integrated Service Networks to coordinate care for dually enrolled veterans, utilizing case managers and tracking specific metrics.
